schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Post-reconstruction ring corrections applied; severity not documented

schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Steel outer sleeve caused secondary BH and scattering artifact resulting in uneven brightness; corrected with asymmetric + symmetric corrections
